data.name: Reuen
data.long_meaning:
From the Hebrew name 'Ruwach', meaning 'wind' or 'exalted one'. In the Bible, Reuben is the name of the firstborn son of Jacob and Leah.

The name Reuben can be translated as 'Behold, a son' or 'Returning'. As the firstborn son, Reuben was to be the one who would receive the birthright and the blessing from his father. However, he failed to live up to this responsibility and his position was taken by Joseph. Despite this, Reuben remained loyal to his brother and helped him when he was sold into slavery in Egypt.
